full_judgment: 3. The defendant contested the suit contending, inter alia, that Jatish Chandra Roy was never a lunatic and that he lived in Ramganj within Islampur P.S in West Dinajpur, India. That he exchanged his landed properties including the land in suit with the landed properties of the defendant in India within the knowledge of the plaintiff and others. That Thebendra Nath Roy, husband of the plaintiff, in collusion with others hatched up the plan204to grab the properties of Janaki Lal Roy and in that end in view filed cases before the revenue authority for correction of record of right and that in the said cases Thebendra Nath did not mention that Jatish Chandra Roy was a lunatic, rather he stated that Jatish Chandra Roy inherited the properties of his father Janaki Lal Roy. That Jatish Chandra Roy performed `Sradha Ceremony' of his father and that at the time he was a student of S.N. College, Dinajpur that plaintiff had never possessed the land in suit rather the land was in the possession of the contesting defendant and that upon erecting but he (defendant) possessed the land.
